title: 第9章 族会弹劾第10章 混元丹神的传承
content_zh:
“诸位叔祖、叔伯，生意场上你来我往，争名夺利本是再正常不过的事情，因为一时之得失就如此大动干戈，难道我叶家这么多年底蕴还受不了这点风波吗？”
叶倾城依旧无比努力的强撑着，说话沉稳有力，只是那双清澈泛红的眸子，坚强的让人心疼。
“哼！
在座的哪个不是生意场上滚打摸爬了多年的前辈，还用你来教？而且此次张家来势汹汹，分明就是想要置我叶家于死地，哪儿像你说得那般轻松？”
首座上的大伯叶德元冷哼一声道。
“我已经调查过，张家这次请来的炼丹师非同小可，乃是王都丹盟在册的炼丹师，我们叶家的炼丹师根本无法与之抗衡！
而若是我们继续降价，亏损会更加严重，这次我们叶家有大麻烦了！”
他旁边的二伯叶德明也随声附和，一下就挑起了人们心中的危机感。
“你为了那个废物苏尘，不惜拿出镇族宝药，还花费了家族大量财富，就是为了招一个废物入赘，让我叶家成了北荒城的笑柄！
你不严加管教，居然还处处护着他，以至于给我叶家惹下了滔天大祸，这是堂堂叶家少族长该做的事吗？”
“说来说去，这都是你这个少族长办事不利。”
“就是，叶倾城，你还有何话可说？”
众人唾沫横飞，情绪都十分激动，对着叶倾城横加指责。
首座上的叶德元看到这一幕，心中冷冷一笑。
他想要的效果，达到了。
叶倾城心中很委屈，也很愤怒。
这些年她耗费无尽心力，才将叶家的生意急速发展壮大，蒸蒸日上，帮助叶家从一个二流家族，一跃成为北荒城第一豪门。
也让这些人赚的盆满钵满，不再缺少修炼资源。
可他们却没有丝毫感激之心，只要遇到一点危机，让他们利益受损，就会横加指责。
人心怎能如此凉薄？

叶倾城很累，但为了报答族长爷爷的信任，她一直努力坚持着。
而今，苏尘修为被废，入赘叶家，为了苏尘，她就更不能倒下了。
“生意上的事，我会负责，张家的怨气，我也会处理。
爷爷闭关前既然任命我为少族长，我就会担起家族重任！”
叶倾城深吸了一口气，努力支撑着平稳的语气说道。
以前也有不少类似的事情发生，但有族长爷爷的信任和力挺，她总能凭借自己的才智，化险为夷。
“说得好听，既无修为，又非炼丹师的你，拿什么负责？又怎么处理？”
“没有能力，就该退位让贤，总占着茅坑不拉屎，只会害人害己！”
大多数人众口一词对叶倾城横加指责，冷嘲热讽，少数人中立不语，显然有人暗中操控。
见时机差不多了，四叔叶德林站了出来，神情肃然的说道：“既然大家争论不休，那我有个主意，干脆将那个废物赘婿交出去，一了百了。”
他的话得到了很多人的赞同。
一个被苏家遗弃，修为被废的废物赘婿，留着除了浪费粮食，一点用都没有。
若能用他的命化解此次的危机，也算没白在他身上浪费镇族宝药。
“不行！”
一直很冷静的叶倾城突然急了，怒声道：“张家这几年一直图谋我叶家的生意，就算没有苏尘，他们也会发难，此事与苏尘无关。”
张家上个月就请来了炼丹师，暗中抢夺打压叶家的生意。
这个月突然变得明目张胆起来，其中或许有苏尘打伤了两个张家子弟的关系，但最主要的原因还是他们占据了优势，没必要隐藏了。
content_en:
"Uncles, it's normal for you to come and go in the business world, and to compete for fame and profit. Because we are so violent over temporary gains and losses, can't it be that my Ye family has been established for so many years and still can't bear this kind of turmoil?"
Ye Qingcheng still worked hard to hold on, speaking calmly and forcefully, but his clear and red eyes were so strong that it made people feel distressed.
"Hmph!
Which one of you here is not a senior who has been working hard in the business field for many years, and you are still used to teach him? Moreover, this time the Zhang family is coming with force, and they clearly want to kill my Ye family. How can it be as easy as you said? "
The uncle in the first seat, Ye Deyuan, snorted coldly.
"I have already investigated and found that the alchemist invited by the Zhang family this time is no small matter. He is an alchemist registered in the Royal Capital Alchemy Alliance. Our Ye family's alchemist cannot compete with it!
And if we continue to cut prices, the losses will be even more serious. This time our Ye family will be in big trouble! "
Next to him, the second uncle Ye Deming also echoed, which immediately aroused a sense of crisis in people's hearts.
"For that good-for-nothing Su Chen, you didn't hesitate to take out the family's precious medicine and spent a lot of family wealth, just to recruit a good-for-nothing as your wife, making my Ye family the laughing stock of Beihuang City!
You didn't discipline him strictly, but you still protected him at every turn, causing great trouble to my Ye family. Is this what the young patriarch of the Ye family should do? "
"After all, this is all because you, the young patriarch, have done something wrong."
"That's right, Ye Qingcheng, what else do you have to say?"
Everyone was spitting and very excited, accusing Ye Qingcheng.
Ye Deyuan, who was sitting in the first seat, saw this scene and smiled coldly in his heart.
The effect he wanted was achieved.
Ye Qingcheng felt aggrieved and angry.
Over the years, she has spent endless efforts to develop and prosper the Ye family's business rapidly, helping the Ye family to transform from a second-rate family to the most wealthy family in Beihuang City.
It also allows these people to make a lot of money and no longer lack training resources.
But they don't have the slightest sense of gratitude. As long as they encounter a slight crisis and their interests are harmed, they will make accusations.
How can people's hearts be so cold?
Ye Qingcheng was very tired, but in order to repay the trust of the patriarch, she kept working hard.
Now, Su Chen's cultivation was abolished and he joined Ye's family. For Su Chen's sake, she couldn't fall down.
“I will be responsible for business matters, and I will also deal with the Zhang family’s grievances.
Since my grandfather appointed me as the young patriarch before going into seclusion, I will take up the important responsibilities of the family! "
Ye Qingcheng took a deep breath and tried to maintain a steady tone.
Many similar things happened in the past, but with the trust and support of the patriarch, she was always able to save the day with her own intelligence.
"To put it nicely, you who have no cultivation skills and are not an alchemist, what are you responsible for? How should you deal with it?"
"If you don't have the ability, you should give up your position and make way for talents. If you always occupy the manhole and do nothing, you will only harm others and yourself!"
Most people unanimously criticized and ridiculed Ye Qingcheng, while a few people were neutral and silent. It was obvious that someone was secretly controlling.
Seeing that the time was almost up, Fourth Uncle Ye Delin stood up and said solemnly: "Since everyone is arguing endlessly, I have an idea. Let's just hand over the useless son-in-law and let the matter be settled once and for all."
His words were echoed by many people.
A good-for-nothing son-in-law who was abandoned by the Su family and whose cultivation was ruined would have no use at all except a waste of food.
If he could use his life to resolve this crisis, it wouldn't be a waste of the clan's precious medicine on him.
"No!"
Ye Qingcheng, who had always been calm, suddenly became anxious and said angrily: "The Zhang family has been plotting against my Ye family's business in the past few years. Even without Su Chen, they would have made trouble. This matter has nothing to do with Su Chen."
The Zhang family invited an alchemist last month to secretly snatch and suppress the Ye family's business.
This month, things suddenly became blatant. Su Chen may have injured someone among them.The main reason for the relationship between the two Zhang family children is that they have the advantage and there is no need to hide it.
